English: From this perspective, we analysed 30,983 complete SARS-CoV-2 genomes from 79 countries located in the six continents and collected from 24 December 2019, to 13 May 2020, according to the GISAID database.
Luganda: Mu ngeri eno, twekaliriza endagabutonde 30,983 eza SARS-CoV-2 enzijuvu okuva mu mawanga 79 agasangibwa mu ssemazinga mukaaga era ezaakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva nga 24 Ogwekkumineebiri 2019, okutuusa nga 13 Ogwokutaano 2020, okusinziira ku tterekero lya GISAID.
Yoruba: Láti ìhà yìí, a ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ ìpìlẹ̀-ara 30,983 SARS-CoV-2 láti àwọn orílé-ède 79 tó wà ní oríṣiríṣi kọ́ńtínẹ́ẹ̀tì mẹ́fà tí a sì gbà láti 24 oṣù Ọpẹ́ ọdún 2019, títí dé 13 osù Èbìbí 2020, ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú àkójọ dátà ti GISAID.
Zulu: Kulo mbono, sihlaziye izinhlobo zofuzo ze-SARS-CoV-2 eziphelele ezingama-30,983 ezivela emazweni angama-79 akumazwekazi ayisithupha futhi saqoqwa kusukela zingama-24 kuZibandlela wezi-2019, kuya kumhla ziyi-13 kuNhlaba wezi-2020, ngokusho kwesizindalwazi se-GISAID.
Hausa: Daga wannan ra’ayi, mun bincika cikakkun ilahirin ƙwayoyin gadon SARS-CoV-2 guda 30,983 daga ƙasashe 79 da ke cikin nahiyoyi shida kuma muka tattara daga 24 ga watan Disamba 2019, zuwa 13 ga Mayu 2020, bisa ga rumbun bayanan GISAID.
Northern Sotho: Go ya ka kwešišo ye, re sekasekile ditšenounu tše 30,983 tše di feleletšego tša SARS-CoV-2 go tšwa dinageng tše 79 tše di hwetšwago ka dikontinenteng tše tshela le go di kgobokatša go tloga ka la 24 Disemere 2019, go fihla ka la 13 Mei 2020, go ya ka dathapeisi ya GISAID.
Amharic: ከዚህ እይታ በመነሳት፣ በ GISAID የመረጃ ቋት መሰረት ከዲሴምበር 24፣ 2019 እስከ ሜይ 13፣ 2020 በ 6 ስድስት አህጉሮች ውስጥ ከሚገኙ 79 ሃገሮች የተሰበሰቡ 30 983 ሙሉ የሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ጂኖሞችን ተንትነናል፡፡

English: Our analysis revealed the presence of 3206 variant sites, with a uniform distribution of mutation types in different geographic areas.
Luganda: Okwekaliriza kwaffe kwayoleka okubaawo kw’ebifo eby’enjawulo 3206, nga birina ensaasaana y’ebika by’endagabutonde ez’enjawulo efaanagana mu bitundu eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Àtúpalẹ̀ wa fi ààyè ìyàtọ̀ 3206 hàn, pẹ̀lú ìṣọ̀kan ìfọnká irúfẹ́ ìyípadà ní oríṣiríṣi agbègbè.
Zulu: Ukuhlaziya kwethu kuveze ubukhona kwezindawo ezihlukile ze-3206, ezinokusabalalisa okufanayo kwezinhlobo zokuguqulwa kwezakhi ezindaweni ezihlukene.
Hausa: Bincikenmu ya nuna kasancewar ɓangarorin rukunoni 3206, tare da rarraba iri ɗaya na sauyi a yankuna daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Tshekatsheko ya rena e utollotše gore go na le mafelo a 3206 ao go lego mehuta ya malwetši, ao a phatlalatšwago ka tsela ye e swanago ya diphetogo tša ditšini ka ditikologong tše di fapafapanego.
Amharic: ትንተናችን እንዳሳየው 3206 ተለዋዋጭ ቦታዎች ያሉ ሲሆን በተለያዩ የጂኦግራፊያዊ ቦታዎች ወጥ የቅይርታ አይነቶች ስርጭት ታይቷል፡፡

English: Remarkably, a low frequency of recurrent mutations has been observed; only 169 mutations (5.27%) had a prevalence greater than 1% of genomes.
Luganda: Mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, emirundi gy’obweyolesi egya wansi mu nkyukakyuka gizuuliddwa; enkyukakyuka 169 (5.27%) gyokka gye gyalina obweyolesi obusukka ekitundu 1% mu ndagabutonde.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú ìyàlẹ́nu, a ti ṣe àkíyèsí ìgbóhùnsáfẹ́fẹ́ tí ìyípadà lóòrẹ̀kóòrè; ìyípadà 169 péré (5.27%) ní ìtànkálẹ̀ ìpìlẹ̀-ara tí ó tóbi jù pẹ̀lú 1%.
Zulu: Ngokuphawulekayo, imvamisa ephansi yokuguqulwa kwezinguquko eziphindaphindiwe iye yabonwa; izinguquko eziyi-169 kuphela (5.27%) zande ngo-1% kwama-genomes.
Hausa: Abin sha’awa shi ne, an lura da ƙarancin maimaituwar sauyi; sauyi guda 169 kawai ne (kashi 5.27%) suka sami yaɗuwa fiye da kashi 1% na ilahirin ƙwayoyin gadon.
Northern Sotho: Sa go makatša kudu, go lemogilwe ditiragalo tša fase tša diphetogo tša go hlaga kgafetšakgafetša; ke fela diphetogo tše 169 (5.27%) tšeo di bilego le ditiragalo tše di fetago 1% ya ditšenoumu.
Amharic: በሚደንቅ ሁኔታ፣ እየደጋገሙ በሚከሰቱ ቅይርታዎች አነስተኛ ድግግሞሽ የታየ ሲሆን፣ 169 ቅይርታዎች (5.27%)  ከ1% በላይ የጂኖም ስርጭት ነበራቸው፡፡

Yoruba: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé, àwọ́n àmúkù mẹ́rìnlá tí kò bára jọ (>10%) ní a ti ṣèdámọ̀ ní àwọn ibi ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ ní ibi ìpìlẹ̀-ara; mẹ́jọ nínú ORF1ab (nínú nsp2, nsp3, àyè awọ, RdRp, ẹ́líkeèsì, ẹksonukílìs àti ẹndoribonukílíìsì), mẹ́ta nínú amúaradàgbà nukilioscásíìdì, àti ọ̀kà nínú purotéènì mẹ́ta:

Hausa: Duk da haka, an gano sauye-sauye goma sha huɗu waɗanda ba a san su ba (> 10%) a wurare daban-daban tare da ilahirin ƙwayoyin gadon ƙwayar cutar; takwas a cikin ORF1ab polyprotein (a cikin nsp2, nsp3, yankin transmembrane, RdRp, helicase, exonuclease, da endoribonuclease), uku a cikin furotin nucleocapsid, kuma ɗaya a cikin kowane sinadaran guda uku:

Amharic: ሆኖም ግን፣ አስራ አራት የማይመሳሰሉ ሆትስፖት ቅይርታዎች (>10%) በቫይረሱ ጂኖም ውስጥ በተለያዩ ቦታዎች ላይ የተገኙ ሲሆን፣ ስምንቱ በ ORF1ab ፖሊፕሮቲን (in nsp2, nsp3፣ ትራንስሜምበራንስ ጎራ፣ RdRp፣ ሄሊኬዝ፣ ኤክሶኒዩክሊያስ እና ኢንዶሪቦኒዩክሊያስ)፤ ሶስት በኒዩክሊዮካፕሲድ ፕሮቲን ውስጥ እና አንድ ደግሞ በእነዚህ ሶስት ፕሮቲኖች ውስጥ ተገኝቷል፣ ስፓይክ፣

English: Moreover, 36 non-synonymous mutations were identified in the receptor-binding domain (RBD) of the spike protein with a low prevalence (<1%) across all genomes, of which only four could potentially enhance the binding of the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein to the human ACE2 receptor.
Luganda: Ekyo nga kiri awo, enkyukakyuka 36 ezitafaanagana zaazuulibwa mu kitundu kya puloteyini enfunyi ey’ekika kya spike ekiyambako akawuka okuyingira omubiri gw’omuntu (RBD) n’obweyolesi obwa wansi (<1%) mu ndagabutonde zonna, nga muno mwalimu nnya zokka ezaalina obusobozi bw’okuyambako puloteyini ya spike eya SARS-CoV-2 okukwanagana n’ekifunyi ekya ACE2.
Yoruba: Bákan náà, wọ́n ṣe ìdámọ̀ àwọn àmúkù ìyípadà 36 inú ilé àṣẹ olùgbà (RBD) ti purotéènì spike pẹ̀lú ìtànkálẹ̀ tó kéré (<1%) káàkiri àwọn ìpìlẹ̀-ara, èyí tó jẹ́ pé mẹ́rin ni ó lè ní agbára ìmúdára ti SARS-CoV-2 purotéènì wá sókè sí olùgbà ACE2 èẹ̀yàn.
Zulu: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuguqulwa okungafanii okungu-36 kukhonjwe esizindeni sokubopha i-receptor-binding (RBD) yephrotheni ye-spike enokwanda okuphansi (<1%) kuwo wonke ama-genome, mane kuphela angathuthukisa ukubophezela kwe-SARS-CoV-2 yephrotheni ye-spike kumamukeli we-ACE2 wabantu.
Hausa: Haka kuma, an gano sauye guda 36 da ba a san su ba a cikin yankin muhimmin ɓangaren ƙwayar cuta (RBD) na furotin mai kauri tare da ƙarancin yaɗuwa (<1%) a duk nau’o’in ƙwayoyin gadon, waɗanda huɗu ne kawai za su iya haɓaka ɗaurin SARS-CoV- 2 furotin mai kauri ga mai karɓar ACE2 na ɗan’adam.
Northern Sotho: Go feta fao, go lemogilwe diphetogo tše 36 tše di sa swanego go tomeine ye e kgontšhago dibaerase go šwahlela mmeleng (RBD) ya protheine ya sepaeke ye e nago le tiragalo ya fase (<1%) go kgabaganya ditšenoumu ka moka, tšeo go tšona tše dine fela di ka kaonafatšago go šwahlela ga protheine ya sepaeke ya SARS-CoV-2 go seamogedi sa ACE2 mmeleng wa batho.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም፣ 36 የማይመሳሰሉ ቅይርታዎች  በስፓይክ ፕሮቲን ውስጥ በአንሰተኛ ክስተት (<1%) በጂኖሞቹ ዙሪያ ተቀባይ-አገናኝ-ጎራ (ተ.አ.ጎ) ውስጥ የተገኙ ሲሆን፣ ከእነዚህም ሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ስፓይክ ፕሮቲን ከ ACE2 ተቀባይ ጋር የመያያዝ እድሉን ሊጨምሩ የሚችሉት አራቱ ብቻ ናቸው፡፡

English: These results along with intra-genomic divergence of SARS-CoV-2 could indicate that unlike the influenza virus or HIV viruses, SARS-CoV-2 has a low mutation rate which makes the development of an effective global vaccine very likely.
Luganda: Bino ebizuuliddwa gattako n’obwawuko mu ndagabutonde ya SARS-CoV-2 biyinza okwoleka nti obutafaanagana na kawuka akaleeta ssennyiga oba akaleeta mukeenenya, aka SARS-CoV-2 kalina enkyukakyuka ya wansi ekifuula omulimu gw’okukola eddagala erigema erituukiridde okuba nga gusobokera ddala.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsì wọ̀nyí pẹ̀lú fi ìyàtọ̀ inú ìpìlẹ̀-ara ti SARS-CoV-2 lè ṣàfihàn pé yàtọ̀ sí fáírọ́ọ̀sì tó ń ta ko ẹ̀ya ara ìmí tàbí fáírọ́ọ̀sì HIV, SARS-CoV-2 ní òṣùwọ̀n ìyípadà kékeré èyí tó jẹ́ kí ìdàgbàsókè àjẹsára kárí ayé tó múnádóko ṣeéṣe lọ́pọ̀lọpọ̀.
Zulu: Le miphumela kanye nokuhluka kwe-intra-genomic ye-SARS-CoV-2 kungakhombisa ukuthi ngokungafani negciwane lomkhuhlane noma amagciwane e-HIV, i-SARS-CoV-2 inenani eliphansi lokuguquka okwenza ukuthuthukiswa komgomo osebenzayo womhlaba wonke kube maningi kakhulu amathuba.
Hausa: Waɗannan sakamakon tare da bambance-bambancen juyin ƙwayoyin gado na SARS-CoV-2 suna iya nuna cewa ba kamar ƙwayar cutar mura ko ƙwayoyin cutar HIV ba, SARS-CoV-2 yana da ƙarancin sauyi wanda yake ba da yiwuwar haɓaka ingantaccen rigakafin duniya.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tše gammogo le pharologantšho ya tšenomiki tša ka gare tša SARS-CoV-2 di ka laetša gore go se swane le baerase ya mpshikela goba dibaerase tša HIV, SARS-CoV-2 e na le kelo ya fase ya phetogo ye e hlolago gore go tšweletšwe moento wo o ka šomago gabotse lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: እነዚህ ውጤቶች ከሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ውስጠ-ጂኖሚያዊ ልዩነት ጋር አንድ ላይ በመሆን፣ ከኤችአይቪ እና ከኢንፍሉዌንዛ ቫይረስ በተለየ መልኩ፣ ሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ዝቅ ያለ የቅይርታ ምጥነት ስላለው ውጤታማ አለም-አቀፋዊ ክትባት መስራት የመቻል እድልን በጣም ከፍተኛ ያደርገዋል፡፡

English: In 2020, researchers observed small changes in the genome of SARS-CoV-2 as it was spreading across the world.
Luganda: Mu 2020, abanoonyereza baazuula enkyukakyuka ntono mu ndagabutonde ya SARS-CoV-2 bwe yali ng’esaasaana okwetooloola ensi.
Yoruba: Ní 2020, àwọn oníwádìí rí àwọn ìyípadà pẹ́ẹ́pẹ̀ẹ̀pẹ́ kan nínú ìpìlẹ̀-ara ti SARS-CoV-2 gẹ́gẹ́ bí ó ti ń tàn kálẹ̀ káàkiri àgbáyé.
Zulu: Ngo-2020, abacwaningi babone izinguquko ezincane kwi-genome ye-SARS-CoV-2 isabhebhetheka emhlabeni wonke.
Hausa: A cikin shekarar 2020, masu bincike sun lura da ƙananan sauye-sauye a cikin ilahirin ƙwayoyin halittar SARS-CoV-2 yayin da take yaɗuwa a faɗin duniya.
Northern Sotho: Ka 2020, banyakišiši ba lemogile diphetogo tše nnyane ka go tšenoumu ya SARS-CoV-2 ge e be e phatlalala le lefase ka bophara.
Amharic: በ2020 በአለም ዙሪያ እየተስፋፋ በነበረበት ወቅት ተመራማሪዎች በሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ጄኖም ላይ አነስተኛ ለውጦችን አይተዋል፡፡

English: Scientists said if a virus has such few changes over time, developing one global COVID-19 vaccine would be easier.
Luganda: Bannassaayansi baagamba nti singa akawuka kabeera n’enkyukakyuka ntono ng’ezo ebbanga nga liyiseewo, okukola eddagala erigema COVID-19 mu nsi yonna kuba kujja kuba kwangu.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì sọ pé tí fáírọ́ọ̀sì kan bá ní irú àwọn àyípadà diẹ̀díẹ̀ ṣáájú ìgbà, ṣíṣẹ̀dá àjẹ́sára COVID-19 tó jẹ́ káríayé ni yóò rọrùn.
Zulu: Ososayensi bathe uma igciwane liba nezinguquko ezimbalwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukwenza umgomo owodwa we-COVID-19 kungaba lula.
Hausa: Masana kimiyyar sun ce idan ƙwayar cutar tana da irin waɗannan ‘yan sauye-sauye a kan lokaci, haɓaka rigakafin cutar COVID-19 guda ɗaya na duniya zai yi sauƙi.
Northern Sotho: Ditsebi tša mahlale di boletše gore ge e ba baerase e ba le diphetogo tšeo tše nnyane mo nakong e telele, go tšweletša moento o tee wa COVID-19 wa lefase go tla ba bonolo kudu.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶቹ እንዳሉት በጊዜ ብዛት አንድ ቫይርስ እንዲህ አነስተኘ ለውጦችን ብቻ የሚያሳይ ከሆነ፣ አለም-አቀፋዊ የሆነ አንድ የኮቪድ-19 ክትባት መስራትን ቀላል ያደርገዋል፡፡

English: At the time, the COVID-19 virus, SARS-CoV-2, was spreading fast and killing many people, and scientists were working hard to develop an effective vaccine.
Luganda: Mu kiseera ekyo, akawuka ka COVID-19, SARS-CoV-2, kaali kasaasaana ku mbiro eza waggulu era nga katta abantu bangi, era bannassaayansi baali bakola butaweera okukola eddagala erigema erituukiridde.
Yoruba: Ní ìgbà náà, fáírọ́ọ̀sì COVID-19 náà, SARS-CoV-2, ń tàn kálẹ̀ kiri gan tó sì ń pa ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ èèyaǹ, àti pé àwọn onímọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì ń ṣiṣẹ́ kárakára láti lè ṣẹ̀dá àjẹsára tó múnádóko.
Zulu: Ngaleso s’khathi, igciwane le-COVID-19, SARS-CoV-2, belibhebhetheka ngokushesha futhi libulala abantu, ososayensi bebesebenza kanzima ukwakho umgomo osebenzayo.
Hausa: A lokacin, ƙwayar cutar COVID-19, SARS-CoV-2, tana yaɗuwa cikin sauri kuma tana kashe mutane da yawa, kuma masana kimiyya suna aiki tuƙuru don haɓaka ingantaccen rigakafi.
Northern Sotho: Nakong yeo, baerase ya COVID-19, SARS-CoV-2, e be e phatlalala ka lebelo ebile e bolaya batho ka bontši, gomme ditsebi tša mahlale di be di šoma ka maatla go tšweletša moento wo o tla šomago ka tshwanelo.
Amharic: በጊዜው፣ የኮቪድ-19 ቫይረስ ሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 በጣም በፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ ስለነበር ብዙ ሰዎችን ገድሏል፤ ሳይንቲስቶች ደግሞ ውጤታማ ክትባት ለመስራት ጠንክረው እየሰሩ ነበር፡፡

English: They followed changes in the virus genome and looked at how fast the changes occured in different parts of the world.
Luganda: Baalondoola enkyukakyuka mu ndagabutonde y’akawuka ne beekaliriza embiro enkyukakyuka gye zaabangawo mu bitundu by’ensi eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tẹ̀lé àwọn ìyípadà inú fáírọ́ọ̀sì ìpìlẹ̀-ara àti láti wo bí ìyípadà ti ń wáyé ní oríṣiríṣi igun àgbáyé.
Zulu: Balalndele izinguquko kwi-genome yegciwane babheka ukuthi zishesha kangakanani ezindaweni ezihlukene.
Hausa: Sun bi sauye-sauye a cikin ilahirin ƙwayoyin gado na ƙwayar cutar kuma sun duba yadda sauye-sauye suka yi sauri a sassa daban-daban na duniya.
Northern Sotho: Ba lekodišitše diphetogo go tšenoumu ya baerase le go lebelela lebelo leo diphetogo di hlagilego ka gona go dikarolo tše di fapafapanego tša lefase.
Amharic: በቫይረሱ ጂኖም ላይ የተከሰቱ ለውጦችን በመከተል በተለያዩ የአለም ክፍሎች ላይ ለውጦቹ በምን ያህል ፍጥነት እንደተፈጠሩ አስተውለዋል፡፡

English: The information was intended to help them to manage the COVID-19 disease better, and to develop a vaccine that will be effective against all circulating virus strains.
Luganda: Obubaka bwagenderera kubayambako okulwanyisa obulungi endwadde ya COVID-19, wamu n’okukola eddagala erigema erinaakola ku bika by’obuwuka eby’enjawulo ebyali bisaasaana.
Yoruba: Wọ́n lérò láti fi àlàyé náà ṣe ìrànwọ́ fún wọn láti lè mójú tó ààrùn COVID-19 dáadáa, àti láti lè ṣe àjẹ́sára kan tó lè kájú àwọn fáírọ́ọ̀sì káàkiri.
Zulu: Ulwazi beluhlose ukubasiza ngokugada isifo se-COVID-19 kangcono, nokwakha umgomo ongasebenza kuzo zonke izinguquko zegciwane.
Hausa: An yi nufin bayanin ne don taimaka musu don sarrafa cutar ta COVID-19 da kyau, da kuma samar da rigakafin da zai yi tasiri ga duk nau’o’in ƙwayar cutar da suke yawo.
Northern Sotho: Tshedimošo e be e nepile go ba thuša go laola bolwetši bja COVID-19 bokaone, le go tšweletša moento wo o tla šomago gabotse twantšhong ya mehuta ka moka ya dibaerase tše di phatlalalago.
Amharic: መረጃው የኮቪድ-19 በሽታን በተሻለ መልኩ ለማስተዳደር እንዲያግዛቸው እና ተንሰራፍተው ላሉት የቫይረስ አይነቶች ሁሉ ውጤታማ የሆነ ክትባትን ለመስራት እንዲችሉ ለመርዳት ያለመ ነበር፡፡

English: In this study, the researchers analysed changes in the SARS-CoV-2 genome in different parts of the world.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza beekaliriza enkyukakyuka mu ndagabutonde ya SARS-CoV-2 mu bitundu by’ensi eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn oníwádìí ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ àwọn ìyípadà inú ìpìlẹ̀-ara SARS-CoV-2 ní oríṣiríṣi igun àgbáyé.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bahlaziye izinguquko ze-genome ye-SARS-CoV-2 ezindaweni ezahlukene emhlabeni.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu binciken sun bincika sauye-sauye a cikin ilahirin ƙwayoyin halittar SARS-CoV-2 a sassa daban-daban na duniya.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba sekasekile diphetogo go tšenoumu ya SARS-CoV-2 go dikarolo tše di fapafapanego tša lefase.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎቹ በሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ጂኖም ላይ የሚከሰቱትን ሁሉንም ለውጦች ገምግመዋል፡፡

English: They also looked at possibly developing a global vaccine against all SARS-CoV-2 strains.
Luganda: Baatunuulira n’ensonga y’okukola eddagala erigema ebika bya SARS-CoV-2 byonna mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún wo ọ̀nà tó ṣeéṣe láti ṣèdá àjẹsára tó jẹ́ káríayé tó lódì sí gbogbo SARS-CoV-2 inú iṣan.
Zulu: Baphinde babheka amathuba okwenza umgomo ozolwa nazo zonke izinguquko ze-SARS-CoV-2 emhlabeni wonke.
Hausa: Sun kuma duba yiwuwar haɓaka rigakafin duniya a kan duk nau’o’in SARS-CoV-2.
Northern Sotho: Ba lebeletše le kgonagalo ya go tšweletša moento wa lefase twantšhong ya mehuta ka moka ya SARS-CoV-2.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ሁሉንም የሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 አይነቶችን ሊከላከል የሚችል አለም-አቀፋዊ ክትባት የመስራት አማራጭን አስሰዋል፡፡

English: The researchers collected complete SARS-CoV-2 genome sequences information from 79 countries in 6 continents from a database, and analysed these.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakuŋŋaanya obubaka bwa SARS-CoV-2 obujjuvu okuva mu mawanga 79 mu ssemazinga 6 okuva mu tterekero era ne babwekaliriza.
Yoruba: Àwọn oníwádìí gba àlàyé SARS-CoV-2 tó pé ní tẹ̀lé-ǹ-tẹ̀lé láti orílé-èdè 79 ní kọ́ńtínẹ́ẹ̀tì 6 láti ibi àkójọ dátà kan, wọ́n dẹ̀ ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ àwọn èyí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqoqe imininingwane ephelele ye-SARS-CoV-2 emazweni awu-79 emazwenikazi awu-6 base bewahlaziya.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun tattara cikakkun bayanai game da jerin ilahirin ƙwayoyin gadon SARS-CoV-2 daga ƙasashe 79 a cikin nahiyoyi guda 6 daga wani rumbun bayanai, kuma sun yi nazarin waɗannan.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba kgobokeditše tshedimošo ka moka ya ditatelantšho tša tšenoumu tša SARS-CoV-2 go tšwa dinageng tše 79 ka dikontinenteng tše 6 go tšwa go dathapeisi, le go di sekaseka.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከመረጃ ቋት ላይ በ6 አህጉሮች ባሉ 79 ሃገሮች ሙሉ የሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ጂኖም የቅደም ተከተል መረጃን ሰብስበው ገምግመዋል፡፡

English: They analysed the type and prevalence of changes in each genome.
Luganda: Beekaliriza ekika n’okubaawo kw’enkyukakyuka mu buli ndagabutonde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ irúfẹ́ àti àyípadà inú ìpìlẹ̀-ara kọ̀kan tó ń ṣe lemọ́lemọ́.
Zulu: Bahlaziye inhlobo nezinguquko ezivamile kwe-genome ngayinye.
Hausa: Sun yi nazari a kan nau’in da yaɗuwar canje-canje a cikin kowane ilahirin ƙwayoyin gadon.
Northern Sotho: Ba sekasekile mohuta le ditiragalo tša diphetogo go tšenoumu ye nngwe le ye nngwe.
Amharic: የእያንዳንዱን ጂኖም አይነት እና የለውጥ መስፋፋት ተንትነዋል፡፡

English: The researchers also compared SARS-CoV-2 genomes across countries, and made family trees to show relationships between the strains.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baageraageranya endagabutonde za SARS-CoV-2 okwetooloola amawanga, era ne bakuba omuti okulaga oluganda oluli mu bika eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Àwọn oníwádìí tún ṣẹ àfiwé ìpìlẹ̀-ara SARS-CoV-2 káàkiri àwọn oríléèdè, ó sì jẹ́ kí òpó ẹbí fi ìbáṣepọ̀ hàn láàárín wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde baqhathanisa ama- genomes e-SARS-CoV-2 emazweni ahlukene base bebheka ubuhlobo kulezi zinguquko.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma kwatanta ilahirin ƙwayoyin gadon SARS-CoV-2 a duk faɗin ƙasashe, kuma sun sanya bishiyoyin dangi don nuna alaƙa a tsakanin nau’o’in.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bapeditše le ditšenoumu tša SARS-CoV-2 go akaretša dinaga, le go dira mašika a tswalano go bontšha dikamano magareng ga mehuta.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ተመራማሪዎቹ በሃገሮች ዙሪያ የሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ጂኖሞችን አወዳድረው በተለያዩ የቫይረስ አይነቶች መሃል ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማሳየት የዘር ሃረጎችን ሰርተዋል፡፡

English: Their results showed only small changes in the SARS-CoV-2 genomes in all countries studied.
Luganda: Bye baazuula byayoleka enkyukakyuka ntono mu ndagabutonde za SARS-CoV-2 mu mawanga gonna ageekalirizibwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn àbájáde wọn fi àyípadà kékeré nìkan hàn nínú ìpìlẹ̀-ara SARS-CoV-2 ní gbogbo oríléèdè tí wọ́n gbé yẹ̀wò.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo iveze izinguquko ezincane kuma-genomes e-SARS-CoV-2 emazweni acwaningiwe.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya nuna ƙananan sauye-sauye a cikin ilahirin ƙwayoyin gadon SARS-CoV-2 a duk ƙasashen da aka yi nazari.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di bontšhitše diphetogo tše nnyane go ditšenoumu tša SARS-CoV-2 ka dinageng ka moka tše di bego di nyakišišwa.
Amharic: እነዚህ ውጤቶች በተጠኑት ሃገሮች ሁሉ በሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ጂኖሞች ላይ አንስተኛ ለውጦችን አሳይተዋል፡፡

English: Very few samples (5.27%) had changes in more than 1% of the entire genome.
Luganda: Sampolo ntono nnyo (5.27%) ezaalina enkyukakyuka mu kitundu 1% eky’endagabutonde zonna.
Yoruba: Àwọn àyẹ̀wò díẹ̀ (5.27%) ní àwọn àyípada tí ó ju 1% ti gbogbo ìpilẹ̀-ara.
Zulu: Amasampula am’balwa (5.27) abenoshintsho adlula u-1% kuwo onke ama-genome.
Hausa: Ƙananan samfurori (kashi 5.27%) sun sami sauye-sauye a fiye da 1% na dukkanin ilahirin ƙwayoyin gado.
Northern Sotho: Ke disampole tše nnyane fela (5.27%) tše di bilego le diphetogo tša go feta 1% ya tšenoumu ka moka.
Amharic: በመላው ጂኖም አነስተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው ናሙናዎች (5.27%) ከ 1% በላይ ለውጥን አሳይተዋል፡፡

English: For all the 6 continents, the researchers reported few occurrences of changes happening in the same place in the virus genome.
Luganda: Mu ssemazinga 6 zonna, abanoonyereza baaloopa okubaawo kw’enkyukakyuka eziri mu kitundu ekimu kutono mu ndagabutonde z’akawuka.
Yoruba: Fún gbogbo àwọn kọ́ńtínẹ́ẹ̀tì 6, àwọn oníwádìí ròyìn àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ díẹ̀ tí ìyípadà ti ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní ibi kan náà ní ìpìlẹ̀-ara.
Zulu: Kuwo onke amazwekazi ayi-6, abacwaningi babike izehlakalo ezidale izinguquko ezenzeka endaweni eyodwa kwi-genome yegciwane.
Hausa: Ga dukkan nahiyoyin guda 6, masu binciken sun ba da rahoton ‘yan abubuwan da suka faru na sauye-sauye da suke faruwa a wuri guda a cikin ilahirin ƙwayoyin halitta na ƙwayar cutar.
Northern Sotho: Go dikontinente ka moka tše 6, banyakišiši ba begile ditiragalo tše mmalwa tša diphetogo tše di hlagilego lefelong le swanago la tšenoumu ya baerase.
Amharic: ለሁሉም 6 አህጉሮች በተወሰነ ቦታ ላይ በቫይረሱ ጂኖም ውስጥ አነስተኛ የለውጥ ክስተቶች እንደነበሩ ተመራማሪዎቹ ዘግበዋል፡፡

English: Scientists say if many changes occur at the same place of a genome, new virus strains can arise.
Luganda: Bannassaayansi bagamba nti singa enkyukakyuka nnyingi zibaawo mu kitundu kimu eky’endagabutonde, ebika by’akawuka ebipya bisobola okubalukawo.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì sọ pé bí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ìyípadà bá wáyé ní ibi kan náà lára ìpìlẹ̀-ara, àwọn fáírọ́ọ̀sì túntun inú iṣán lè wáyé.
Zulu: Ososayensi bathi izinguquko eziningi zivela endaweni eyodwa kwi-genome, izinhlobo zegciwane ezitsha zingavela.
Hausa: Masana kimiyyar sun ce idan sauye-sauyen da yawa suka faru a wuri guda na ilahirin ƙwayoyin gado iri ɗaya, sababbin nau’o’in ƙwayar cuta na iya tasowa.
Northern Sotho: Ditsebi tša mahlale di bolela gore ge go hlaga diphetogo tše ntši lefelong le swanago la tšenoumu, go ka hlaga mehuta ye meswa ya baerase.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶቹ እንደሚሉት፣ በአንድ በተወሰነ ቦታ ባለ ጂኖም ብዙ ለውጦች ከተከሰቱ አዲስ የቫይረስ አይነቶች ሊፈጠሩ ይችላሉ፡፡

English: The researchers reported that 67.96% of all genome changes they observed in their analysis can affect protein sequences in the virus, but not its structure or function.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ebitundu 67.96% eby’enkyukakyuka z’endagabutonde zonna ze baalaba mu kwekaliriza kwabwe bisobola okukosa ensengeka ya puloteyini mu kawuka, naye si kikula oba omugaso gwako.
Yoruba: Àwọn oníwádìí jábọ̀ pé 67.96% nínú gbogbo iyípada ìpìlẹ̀-ara tí wọ́n wo àtúpalẹ̀ wọn lè ní ipa lórí àwọn purotéènì inú fáírọ́ọ̀sì náà, ṣùgbọ́n kì í ṣe ti ètò tàbí iṣẹ́ rẹ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babike ukuthi u-67.96% wazo zonke izinguquko zamagenomes abazobonile ekuhlaziyeni kwabo kungaba nomthelela ekulandelaneni kwamaphrotheni egciwane, kodwa kungashintshi ukusebenza kwayo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ba da rahoton cewa kashi 67.96% na duk sauye-sauyen ilahirin ƙwayoyin gadon da suka lura a cikin bincikensu suna iya shafar jerin furotin a cikin ƙwayar cutar, amma ba tsarinta ko aikinta ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba begile gore 67.96% tša diphetogo ka moka tša ditšenoumu tše ba di lekodišišitšego go tshekatsheko ya bona di ka ama ditatelantšho tša protheine go baerase, eupša e sego sebopego goba mošomo wa yona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በትንተናቸው ላይ እንዳዩት፣ 67.96% የሚሆኑት ሁሉም የጂኖም ለውጦች በቫይረሱ ውስጥ የሚገኝ የፕሮቲን ቅደም ተከተል ላይ ተጽእኖ ሊኖራቸው ይችላል፤ ነገር ግን በአወቃቀሩ እና በአሰራሩ ላይ ምንም አይነት ተጽእኖ እንደማይኖራቸው ሪፖርት አድርገዋል፡፡

English: Only one third of the changes can affect protein structure or function of the COVID-19 virus.
Luganda: Ekitundu kimu kyakusatu eky’enkyukakyuka kisobola okukosa ekikula kya puloteyini oba omugaso gw’akawuka ka COVID-19.
Yoruba: Ìdá kan nínú mẹ́ta lára àwọn ìyípadà ló lè ní ipa lórí ètò purotéènì tàbí ṣiṣẹ́ ti fáírọ̀ọ̀sì COVID-19.
Zulu: Ingxenye eyodwa yezinguquko ezintathu ingaba nomthelela esakhiweni sephrotheni yegciwane le-COVID-19.
Hausa: Kashi ɗaya bisa uku na sauye-sauyen na iya shafar tsarin furotin ko aikin ƙwayar cuta ta COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Ke fela tee-tharong ya diphetogo ye e ka amago sebopego goba mošomo wa protheine wa baerase ya COVID-19.
Amharic: ከለውጦቹ አንድ ሶስተኛዎቹ ብቻ የኮቪድ-19 ቫይረስ የፕሮቲን አወቃቀር እና አሰራር ላይ ተጽእኖ ሊኖራቸው ይችላል፡፡

English: The researchers found only 2 changes in the viral genome to be common in the 6 continents; others were different across continents.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula enkyukakyuka 2 zokka mu ndagabutonde z’akawuka okuba nga zeeyoleka nnyo mu ssemazinga 6; endala zaali za njawulo okwetooloola ssemazinga.
Yoruba: Àwọn oníwádìí rí àyípadà 2 nínú ìpìlẹ̀-ara tó lọ jára pé ó wọ́pọ̀ ní kọ́ńtínẹ́ẹ̀tì 6 ; àwọn yòókù yàtọ̀ káàkiri àwọn kọ́ńtínẹ́ẹ̀tì.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole izinguquko ezi-2 kuphela kwi-genome yegciwane zivame emazwenikazi ayi-6; ezinye bezihlukile emazwenikazi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano kawai sauye-sauye guda 2 a cikin ilahirin ƙwayoyin gado na ƙwayar cutar da ta zama ruwan dare a cikin nahiyoyi guda 6; wasu sun bambanta a faɗin nahiyoyi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše diphetogo tše 2 fela go tšenoumu ye e nago le baerase tše di swanago ka dikontinenteng tše 6; tše dingwe di be di fapafapana go kgabaganya dikontinente.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በ6ቱ አህጉሮች 2 ተመሳሳይ በቫይረሱ ጂኖም ላይ የሚከሰቱ ለውጦችን ያገኙ ሲሆን፤ ሌሎቹ ግን በአህጉሮቹ ዙሪያ የተለያዩ ነበሩ፡፡

English: Their results also showed that virus strains in Africa were closely related to those in other continents, and all strains in other continents originated from Asia.
Luganda: Ebizuulo byabwe era byayoleka nti ebika by’akawuka mu Afrika byali bifaanagana nnyo n’eby’omu ssemazinga endala, ate era n’ebika byonna mu ssemazinga endala byasibuka mu Asia.
Yoruba: Èsì wọn tún fi hàn pé àwọn fáírọ́ọ̀sì ní Afrika wà ní ìbátan pẹ̀lú àwọn mìíràn tó wà ní kọ́ńtínẹ́ẹ̀tì mìíràn, àti pé gbogbo àwọn tó wà ní ẹ̀yà àgbáyé mìíràn ṣẹ̀ wá láti Esíà.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo iveze nokuthi izinhlobo zegciwane e-Afrika bezihlobene eduze nalezi zamanye amazwekazi, zonke izinhlobo ezisemazwenikazi zavela e-Asia.
Hausa: Sakamakon binciken nasu ya kuma nuna cewa nau’o’in ƙwayar cutar a Afirka na da alaƙa ta kut-da-kut da na sauran nahiyoyi, kuma dukkan nau’o’in da suke wasu nahiyoyi sun samo asali ne daga Asiya.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di laeditše le gore mehuta ya dibaerase ka Afrika e be e swanetšana kudu le ya ka dikontinenteng tše dingwe, le gore mehuta ka moka ka dikontinenteng tše dingwe e hlagile go tšwa Asia.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ውጤታቸው በአፍሪካ ያሉት የቫይረስ አይነቶች በሌሎች አህጉሮች ከታዩት ጋር ቀረቤታ እንዳላቸው ያሳዩ ሲሆን በሁሉም ሌሎች አህጉሮች ላይ የታዩት የቫይረስ አይነቶች መነሻቸው ኤስያ ነበር፡፡

English: Strains in North America, South America, and Africa come from Europe, while some strains were only in Europe.
Luganda: Ebika eby’enjawulo mu North America, South America, ne Afrika bisibuka mu Bulaaya, ate ng’ebika ebimu byali mu Bulaaya mwokka.
Yoruba: Ìhùwàsí yìí ní Àríwa ́ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà, Gúúsù ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà àti ilẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀ wá láti Yúróòpù, nígbà tí àwọn kọ̀ọ̀kan wà ní Yúróòpù.
Zulu: Izinhlobo zaseNyakatho neMelika, iNingizimu neMelika, nezase-Afrika zivela eYurophu, ezinye izinhlobo beziseYurophu kuphela.
Hausa: Nau’o’in a Arewacin Amurka da Kudancin Amurka da Afirka sun fito ne daga Turai, yayin da wasu nau’o’in suna cikin Turai kawai.
Northern Sotho: Mehuta ya Amerika Borwa, Amerika Leboa, le Afrika e tšwa Yuropa, mola mehuta ye mengwe e be e le ka Yuropa fela.
Amharic: የሰሜን አሜሪካ፣ የደቡብ አሜሪካ እና የአፍሪካ የቫይረስ አይነቶች የሚመጡት ከአውሮፓ ሲሆን፣ አንዳንድ የቫይረስ አይነቶች ደግሞ ከአውሮፓ ብቻ መጥተዋል፡፡

English: The researchers said that the DNA sequence changes in something called the ‘S protein’, do not seem to affect its structure, and therefore are not likely to have a big impact on vaccine effectiveness.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti enkyukakyuka mu nsengeka ya DNA mu kintu ekiyitibwa ‘S protein’, tezirabika kuba nga zikosa ekikula kyayo, noolwekyo tezirabika kuba nga zirina enkyukakyuka ya maanyi ku butuukamu bw’eddagala erigema.
Yoruba: Àwọn oníwádìí sọ wí pé àyípadà ń dé bá ègé DNA nínú nǹkan tí à ń pè ní 'purotéènì S', kò dà bí i pé ó ṣe ohun kan fún ètò rẹ̀, nítorí náà ó lè má ní ipa púpọ̀ nínú ìmúnádóko àjẹsára.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe izinguquko zokulandelana kofuzo entweni ebizwa nge ‘S protein’ azibi namthelela esakhiweni futhi ngeke zibe nomthelela omkhulu wokusebenza komgomo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce jerin ƙwayoyin halittar DNA suna sauyawa a cikin wani abu da ake kira 'S furotin', da alama ba zai shafi tsarinsa ba, don haka, ba zai iya yin babban tasiri kan tasirin rigakafin ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore diphetogo tša ditatelantšho tša DNA go seo se bitšwago ‘protheine ya S’, ga di laetše di ama sebopego sa tšona, ka gona ga go laetše di ka ba le seabe se segolo mabapi le go šoma gabotse ga moento.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳሉት የዲኤንኤ የቅደም ተከተል ለውጦች ‘S ፕሮቲን’ የሚባሉ ሲሆን አወቃቀሩ ላይ ምንም አይነት ተጽእኖ ያላቸው አይመስልም፡፡ ስለዚህ በክትባት ውጤታማነት ላይ ትልቅ ተጽእኖ የማምጣት አዝማሚያቸው አነስተኛ ነው፡፡

English: Scientists are interested in the ‘S protein’ when they develop vaccines because it is the protein used by the virus to enter human cells.
Luganda: Bannassaayansi baagala ‘S protein’ bwe baba bakola eddagala erigema kubanga ye puloteyini akawuka gye kakozesa okuyingira obutaffaali bw’omuntu.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì nífẹ̀ẹ́ sí ' purotéènì S' nígbà tí wọ́n ṣe àgbékalẹ̀ àjẹ́sára nítorí o jẹ́ amáradàgbà tí fáírọ́ọ̀sì náà ń gbà wọ inú àgọ́ ara èèyàn.
Zulu: Ososayensi banentshisekelo ku-‘S protein’ uma benza imigomo ngoba iyiphrotheni esetshenziswa igciwane ukungena kumaseli womuntu.
Hausa: Masana kimiyya suna da sha’awa a kan sinadarin ‘S furotin’ a lokacin da suke samar da alluran rigakafi domin shi ne furotin da ƙwayar cutar take amfani da shi wajen shiga ƙwayoyin halitta na ɗan’adam.
Northern Sotho: Ditsebi tša mahlale di na le kgahlego go ‘protheine ya S’ ge ba tšweletša meento ka gore ke protheine ye e šomišwago ke baerase go tsena diseleng tša batho.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶች ክትባት በሚሰሩበት ጊዜ ‘S ፕሮቲን’ ላይ አተኩረው ነበር፤ ይህም የሆነበት ምክንያት ቫይረሱ የሰዎች ሴል ውስጥ ለመግባት ፕሮቲኑን ስለሚጠቀም ነው፡፡

English: The study showed that unlike the flu virus or HIV, the SARS-CoV-2 genome did not change very fast, which would have made it easy for scientists to develop one global COVID-19 vaccine.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwalaga nti obutafaanana na kawuka akaleeta ssennyiga oba HIV, endagabutonde za SARS-CoV-2 tezaakyuka mangu nnyo, ekyandyanguyisizza bannassaayansi okukola eddagala erigema COVID-19 ery’omulundi ogumu mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìi ́fi hàn pé yàtọ̀ sí fáírọ́ọ̀sì tó ń bá ẹ̀ya ara ìmí jà tàbí HIV, ìpìlẹ̀-ara SARS-CoV-2 ò tètè yípadà, èyí tí kò bá jẹ́ ìrọ̀ruǹ fún àwọn onímọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì láti lè ṣe àgbékalẹ̀ àjẹsára káríayé COVID-19.
Zulu: Ucwaningo luveze ukuthi ngokungafani negciwane lomkhuhlane noma i-HIV, i-SARS-CoV-2 genome ayizange ishintshe ngokushesha, obekungenza kube lula kososayensi ukuthi bakhe umuthi wokugomela i-COVID-19 womhlaba wonke.
Hausa: Binciken ya nuna cewa ba kamar ƙwayar cutar mura ko ƙwayar cutar HIV ba, ƙwayar halittar SARS-CoV-2 ba ta sauya da sauri ba, wanda zai sauƙaƙe wa masana kimiyya don haɓaka rigakafin cutar COVID-19 na duniya guda ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di bontšhitše gore go fapana le baerase ya mokhohlane goba ya HIV, tšenoumu ya SARS-CoV-2 ga se ya fetoga ka lebelo kudu, seo se ka bago se nolofaditše mošomo wa ditsebi tša mahlale go tšweletša moento o tee wa COVID-19 lefaseng ka bophara.
